title: Notes Image Batch Message
description: Message published by the Telegram bot to the 'notes.images' queue when a user sends one or more images. Consumed by the pipeline-worker.

batch_id.description: Unique batch identifier for correlating the request with the result

chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID where the image was sent

file_ids.description: Telegram file_ids to fetch the image content

caption.description: Optional caption text attached to the images
